shape.name: three-direction-routing-branch
shape.description: A substantial common stem separates into exactly three light bundles. The center branch goes rearward in 3D, so oblique views retain three distinct ends.
shape.silhouette: A forked three-route tree with an explicit junction, never a three-petal loop.
shape.label: 三方向の分岐

motion.phaseMeaning: 0→0.28 follows the common trunk from bottom to junction; 0.28→1 follows each branch from junction to its endpoint. group 0 is common trunk; groups 1–3 are selectable destinations.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Brighten the trunk and one selected branch in sequence. Keep the other branches at base brightness so the three-direction identity never disappears.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
